changes.title: Fix six faults seen by using build 437
changes.detail:
Each was seen in the published image on a throwaway instance. None of the fixes has been seen in a browser yet.

- Automation tools on a phone: a fixed stage height meant for wide windows also applied to small ones, so the content stopped about 168 px above the bottom and cards and buttons were cut. The fixed height now applies to wide, tall windows only. The flow view lays the graph out top to bottom when left to right would need too small a scale, so no node is cut on open. - Session clock on a phone: its offset ignored the bottom bar's real height and the device inset, so it sat on the bar on dashboards and over a card on Settings. It now sits in its own row right above the bar on every page, and inside the page area on wide windows. The setting is also sent to the server when the page is hidden, not only when it is unloaded. - Storage: "NaN rows" for an entity and in the growth line. Formatted strings were being passed where the plural rules need numbers, and missing counts leaked into sums. Unknown counts now read as words. - Lights: the page name was shown three times; the toolbar keeps it. - "Continue on error for all actions": clicking the label now toggles the switch. - Au
changes.detail_yue: 執返 437 版真係用過見到嘅六個問題：手機工具面板內容唔夠高、流程圖切咗 節點；時鐘小圖示喺手機有時壓住底欄有時遮住卡；儲存頁出「NaN 行」； 燈光頁標題出三次；「所有動作出錯都繼續」個標籤撳唔到；儲存列文字斷三行。 另外補返粵語覆蓋清單，等個測試唔再紅。全部未喺瀏覽器睇。
